evidence: Touches src/ipc/libmultiprocess and src/ipc/capnp infrastructure, adding native cancellation support to proxy generation and IPC RPC handling.
rationale: It adds native request cancellation support to libmultiprocess and IPC proxy generation, allowing clients to cancel blocking calls by dropping response promises. Per ryanofsky's review, this enables simpler and more efficient cancellation without issuing out-of-band IPC calls.
